karty.priklad: Croeson ni'r ffin i Loegr ar ôl brecwast.
karty.priklad_cs: We crossed the border into England after breakfast (Lloegr → [L]oegr after i).
karty.mnemo: Latin FINis (the end): the border is lit by a row of flaring red torches – this is where it ends.

extra.pozn: croesi = to cross (L2); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r llyfr yn cael ei argraffu gan wasg fach yng Nghaerfyrddin.
karty.priklad_cs: The book is being printed by a small press in Carmarthen (gwasg → [w]asg after gan; bach → [f]ach after the feminine gwasg; Caerfyrddin → [Ngh]aerfyrddin after yng).
karty.mnemo: gwasgu = to squeeze (L8): the press squeezes the paper, and a red belt squeezes your waist.

extra.pozn: y wasg = the press, journalists; gwasgu = to squeeze (L8); present passive with cael (p. 195); own example

karty.priklad: Ro'n i'n arfer chwarae ar fy mhen fy hun yn yr iard.
karty.priklad_cs: I used to play on my own in the yard (pen → [mh]en after fy).
karty.mnemo: From English yard: a yard paved with red bricks baking in the sun.

extra.pozn: ar fy mhen fy hun = on my own; sentence based on the reading on p. 199

karty.priklad: Mae'r plant wedi gwneud roced fach o boteli plastig.
karty.priklad_cs: The children have made a little rocket out of plastic bottles (bach → [f]ach after the feminine roced; poteli → [b]oteli after o).
karty.mnemo: From English rocket: a rocket with a fiery red tail.

extra.pozn: gofod = space (L16); own example

karty.priklad: Gawsoch chi siwrnai dda?
karty.priklad_cs: Did you have a good journey? (da → [dd]a after the feminine siwrnai; cawsoch → [g]awsoch in the question)
karty.mnemo: French journée (a day): a whole day's journey on a red double-decker bus.

extra.pozn: in colloquial writing also siwrne (Siwrne saff! = Safe journey!); taith = journey, trip; own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r streic yn cael ei galw gan y gweithwyr yn y gwaith dur.
karty.priklad_cs: The strike is being called by the workers at the steelworks.
karty.mnemo: From English strike: strikers warming their hands round a glowing brazier.

extra.pozn: ei galw: after ei = her (streic is feminine) there would be an aspirate mutation, but g doesn't change; streiciwr = striker (L16); sentence from the exercise on p. 196

karty.priklad: Rhaid i ni gwblhau'r holl dasgau cyn y dyddiad cau.
karty.priklad_cs: We must complete all the tasks before the deadline (tasgau → [d]asgau after holl; cwblhau → [g]wblhau after i ni).
karty.mnemo: From English task: a task scrawled in red marker on the whiteboard.

extra.pozn: sentence from the dialogue Prysur yn y gwaith, p. 194

karty.priklad: Ces i fy nhrwydded yrru pan o'n i'n ddeunaw oed.
karty.priklad_cs: I got my driving licence when I was eighteen (trwydded → [nh]rwydded after fy; gyrru → [y]rru after the feminine trwydded; deunaw → [dd]eunaw after 'n).
karty.mnemo: A licence proves your TRUE ID (TRW-YDD-ed) – stamped with a red wax seal.

extra.pozn: trwydded yrru = driving licence; own example

sever.priklad: Ges i fy nhrwydded yrru pan o'n i'n ddeunaw oed.
sever.priklad_cs: I got my driving licence when I was eighteen (trwydded → [nh]rwydded after fy; gyrru → [y]rru after the feminine trwydded; deunaw → [dd]eunaw after 'n).
sever.pozn: north: ges i instead of ces i (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Mae'r te 'ma'n dod o Tsieina.
karty.priklad_cs: This tea comes from China.
karty.mnemo: CHINA (TSIEINA), lit by rows of red paper lanterns.

extra.pozn: Ts- doesn't mutate; Tsieinëeg = Chinese (language) (outside the coursebook); sentence based on the reading about the tea room, p. 189

karty.priklad: Mae'r awdurdod lleol eisiau cau'r ysgol.
karty.priklad_cs: The local authority wants to close the school.
karty.mnemo: awdur (author) → AUTHOR-ity: a cold official in a blue uniform.

extra.pozn: awdurdod lleol = local authority; based on Bwletin Newyddion (school closure), p. 198; own example

sever.priklad: Mae'r awdurdod lleol isio cau'r ysgol.
sever.priklad_cs: The local authority wants to close the school.

karty.priklad: Fy mwriad i yw gorffen y cwrs eleni.
karty.priklad_cs: My intention is to finish the course this year (bwriad → [m]wriad after fy).
karty.mnemo: bwrw = to throw (L11): your intention is where you aim your throw – a blue dart.

extra.pozn: bwriadu = to intend (L17); own example

sever.priklad: Fy mwriad i ydy gorffen y cwrs eleni.
sever.priklad_cs: My intention is to finish the course this year (bwriad → [m]wriad after fy).

karty.priklad: Beth oedd canlyniad y gêm?
karty.priklad_cs: What was the result of the game?
karty.mnemo: canlyn = to follow: the result is what follows – lit up on a blue scoreboard.

extra.pozn: Geirfa L15 (p. 187); also in the news glossary, section Chwaraeon (p. 263); own example

sever.priklad_cs: What was the result of the game?

karty.priklad: Roedd y plant yn cuddio yn yr hen gwt gwair.
karty.priklad_cs: The children were hiding in the old hay shed (cwt → [g]wt after hen).
karty.mnemo: cwt ~ COT: a hut no bigger than a cot, full of hay and frost.

extra.pozn: cwt = hut, shed; in the south colloquially also tail, queue (outside the coursebook); gwair = hay; plural outside the coursebook; own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r llwynog wedi bod yn y cwt ieir eto!
karty.priklad_cs: The fox has been in the hen house again!
karty.mnemo: cwt (hut) + ieir (hens, singular iâr): a hen house with icicles hanging from the roof.

extra.pozn: iâr (f) / ieir = hen; plural outside the coursebook; own example

karty.priklad: Mae gwaith dur mawr ym Mhort Talbot.
karty.priklad_cs: There's a big steelworks in Port Talbot (Port → [Mh]ort after ym).
karty.mnemo: Latin DURus (hard), as in DURable: steel as hard and cold as an iceberg.

extra.pozn: gwaith dur = steelworks (p. 196); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r feirws wedi lledu'n gyflym.
karty.priklad_cs: The virus has spread quickly (cyflym → [g]yflym after 'n).
karty.mnemo: From English virus: a virus under the microscope, stained blue.

extra.pozn: f- doesn't mutate; lledu = to spread (L12); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r siaced 'ma wedi'i gwneud o ledr.
karty.priklad_cs: This jacket is made of leather (lledr → [l]edr after o).
karty.mnemo: From English leather: a blue leather jacket stiff with frost.

extra.pozn: cotwm = cotton (L14), sidan = silk (L5), gwlân = wool (L10); wedi'i gwneud: feminine form because of siaced; own example

karty.priklad: Dw i'n siŵr taw dyna oedd y penderfyniad iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: I'm sure that was the right decision.
karty.mnemo: pen (head) + terfyn (limit, end): you draw a line in your head – an ice-clear decision.

extra.pozn: penderfynu = to decide; gwneud penderfyniad = to make a decision; emphatic sentence with taw (revision, p. 190); own example

sever.priklad: Dw i'n siŵr mai dyna oedd y penderfyniad iawn.
sever.priklad_cs: I'm sure that was the right decision.

karty.priklad: Beth yw'r prif bennawd yn y papur heddiw?
karty.priklad_cs: What's the main headline in the paper today? (pennawd → [b]ennawd after prif)
karty.mnemo: pen (head): the headline is the head of the article, printed in big blue letters.

extra.pozn: careful: the plural has one n (penawdau); prif causes soft mutation; penawdau newyddion (p. 188); own example

sever.priklad: Be ydy'r prif bennawd yn y papur heddiw?
sever.priklad_cs: What's the main headline in the paper today? (pennawd → [b]ennawd after prif)
sever.pozn: north: Be ydy instead of Beth yw (L5)

karty.priklad: Mae llawer o bridd ar dy esgidiau di.
karty.priklad_cs: There's a lot of mud on your shoes (pridd → [b]ridd after o).
karty.mnemo: The gardener's PRIDE (PRIDD): a spadeful of frozen soil.

extra.pozn: daear = earth, ground (L8), palu = to dig (L4); own example

karty.priklad: Ganwyd fy nhad-cu yn ystod y rhyfel.
karty.priklad_cs: My grandfather was born during the war (tad-cu → [nh]ad-cu after fy).
karty.mnemo: RHYFEL ~ RIFLE: rifles in a frozen winter war.

extra.pozn: heddwch = peace (L3); Ganwyd = impersonal -wyd form, written style (revision, p. 192); in speech Cafodd fy nhad-cu ei eni yn ystod y rhyfel; own example

sever.priklad: Ganwyd fy nhaid yn ystod y rhyfel.
sever.priklad_cs: My grandfather was born during the war (taid → [nh]aid after fy).

karty.priklad: Mae'n debyg taw'r gacen gaws gyda saws afal yw'r bwyd mwya poblogaidd.
karty.priklad_cs: Apparently the cheesecake with apple sauce is the most popular dish (cacen → [g]acen after 'r, feminine; caws → [g]aws after the feminine cacen).
karty.mnemo: From English sauce: a sauce straight out of the freezer.

extra.pozn: grefi = gravy (L8); sentence from the reading Y Tebot Piws, p. 189

sever.priklad: Mae'n debyg mai'r gacen gaws efo saws afal ydy'r bwyd mwya poblogaidd.
sever.priklad_cs: Apparently the cheesecake with apple sauce is the most popular dish (cacen → [g]acen after 'r, feminine; caws → [g]aws after the feminine cacen).
sever.pozn: north: mai instead of taw (L14), efo instead of gyda (L2), ydy instead of yw (L5)

karty.priklad: Doedd gweld anifeiliaid ecsotig ddim yn syndod i fi.
karty.priklad_cs: Seeing exotic animals was no surprise to me.
karty.mnemo: synnu = to surprise (L3) → syndod: a surprise like an ice cube slipped down your back.

extra.pozn: synnu (L3); syrpréis = surprise (a present, a party, L13); er syndod i bawb = to everyone's surprise; sentence based on the reading on p. 199 (check whether the book has i mi), main clause with southern i fi

sever.priklad: Doedd gweld anifeiliaid ecsotig ddim yn syndod i mi.
sever.priklad_cs: Seeing exotic animals was no surprise to me.
sever.pozn: north: i mi instead of i fi (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Ces i dâl ychwanegol am weithio dros y Nadolig.
karty.priklad_cs: I got extra pay for working over Christmas (tâl → [d]âl as the object after ces i; gweithio → [w]eithio after am).
karty.mnemo: The TALLY (TÂL) of your hours, paid out in ice-cold coins.

extra.pozn: talu = to pay, cael ei dalu = to be paid (p. 195); cyflog = wage, salary (L2); own example

sever.priklad: Ges i dâl ychwanegol am weithio dros y Nadolig.
sever.priklad_cs: I got extra pay for working over Christmas (tâl → [d]âl as the object after ges i; gweithio → [w]eithio after am).
sever.pozn: north: ges i instead of ces i (outside the coursebook)
